links.points_back_to: His standing word that the move on Venezuela is about oil and about buying the dollar a second wind.
links.real_event: He points at a same-day headline that the United States announced a deal securing 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves. His assertion that the word landed is his; whether the deal matches what he actually said stays a validation question.
